lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I just got an email saying my trial has expired and I need to restore access today. That can't be right.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: What makes you say that? It could be an automatic reminder.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: My official dashboard says the trial is active until Friday next week. It also says automatic renewal is off.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Then the claim that it has already expired can't match the account record.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The sender address is odd too. Earlier messages used the workspace's official domain, but this one adds the word “pass” to the address.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That might be a warning sign, but the address alone doesn't prove who sent it.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The email has a button marked “Restore Membership.” It says I have two hours to use it.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: The deadline might be there to create pressure. Still, don't guess at the sender's intention.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: So the strongest evidence is the official dashboard, not the email design.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Right. The message must be using information that conflicts with your current account, but we still need an official check.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I've opened the workspace app from my usual bookmark. There are no payment requests or access warnings.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Can you contact support inside the app?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Yes. The help notice says staff never ask trial users to restore access through an email button.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: In that case, this can't be a genuine renewal notice from the workspace system.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: It might be a misleading message, or it might have been sent to the wrong address. We can't tell which from this screen.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Exactly. State what the evidence supports and stop there.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Here's what we agreed: I won't use the email link, I'll report the message through the app, and support owns the account check.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: When is that due?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I'll report it now. The final answer depends on the support ticket. The only open point is where the message came from.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Good. You can act safely without pretending you know more than the evidence shows.
